# Darby's Pastries

Darby's Pastries is a Bengaluru bakery for custom cakes, celebration cakes, desserts, flowers, chocolates, cake accessories, and gift hampers.

## Key routes

- https://darbyspastries.com/ — storefront and cake catalogue
- https://darbyspastries.com/category/cakes — cakes
- https://darbyspastries.com/custom-cake — custom cake enquiries
- https://darbyspastries.com/policies/:slug — customer policies

For orders and availability, contact Darby's Pastries through the contact options on the website.
